subject: general
question: Big Mart is offering 5% discount on card payment. How much percentage above cost price should the marked price be so as to make a profit of 10%?
solution:
Given:

Discount on the marked price of an article for card payment = 5%

Profit = 10% 

Concept used:

S.P. = C.P. × ((100 + Profit\%))/(100)

Indirect process:-

M.P. = S.P. × (100)/((100 – discount\%))

Calculation:

According to the question,

S.P. = C.P. × (100+10)/(100)

⇒ S.P. = C.P. × (1.1)

⇒ S.P. = (1.1)C.P. 

Now, M.P. = S.P. × (100)/(100-5)

⇒ M.P. = (1.1)C.P. × (100)/(95)

⇒ M.P. = (110)/(95) × C.P.

Now, The percentage by which M.P. is more than C.P. is

= ((M.P - C.P))/(C.P ) × 100

By substituting the value of M.P. in the above equation and simplifying, we get,

= ((110 - 95)×C.P.)/(95×C.P.) × 100

= (300)/(19)%

= 15(15)/(19)%

∴ The Required percentage value is 15(15)/(19)%.
